segments.name: Off-price retail
segments.description: Operates two brands of off-price retail apparel and home fashion stores serving value-driven middle and moderate income customers across the United States.
segments.evidence: The Company has two operating segments; Ross and dd's DISCOUNTS.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Company for first-quality, in-season, brand name and designer apparel, accessories, footwear, and home fashions purchased at its off-price stores.
revenueModel.evidence: Ross offers first-quality, in-season, brand name and designer apparel, accessories, footwear, and home fashions for the entire family at savings of 20% to 60% off department and specialty store regular prices every day.
